requirement: OPS-05: verifiable device sparse forward and backward with CPU comparison, device update and restore tests, and measurement
scope: Opt-in scalar zero-delay continuous episode trainer. Sparse forward drive and backward source/edge derivatives run on WebGPU; state transition, activation and AdamW run on CPU. Encoder and readout retain the existing Insyra path; their device execution was not measured.

environment.machine: Mac15,12 Apple M3, 17179869184 bytes unified memory

input_fingerprints.fixture: learning/gpu_trainer_test.go gpuTrainerFixture: 4 nodes, 5 edges, 4 time steps, float64 CPU reference

observed_result.status: All targeted GPU tests, 20 repeated targeted runs, targeted race run, full learning tests and vet passed on Apple M3 Metal with no GPU skips.
observed_result.cpu_comparison: Predict, four Step updates, StepFrom, parameters and AdamW moments matched CPU within declared float32 path tolerances; core weights changed.
observed_result.restore: In-memory restore and a JSON snapshot written to disk then loaded in a fresh test process continued three updates to the same snapshot as uninterrupted GPU training.
observed_result.device_identity: Forward and backward adapters both reported Apple M3 / Metal.
observed_result.unsupported_configs: LIF, mixed, positive delay, vector state, matrix edge and recompute were rejected explicitly before GPU execution.
observed_result.cpu_only_ci: GPU-required tests skip only when the hardware adapter is unavailable; this CPU-only path was not executed on the Mac.

limitations: The optimizer update is on CPU, not the device; device-resident state saving is not implemented.
Only scalar zero-delay continuous independent episodes are supported. Persistent neural-state operations, LIF, mixed, vector, matrix, delayed and recompute paths are not accelerated.
The GPU data transfer occurs at every time step and the 4-node fixture is not a speedup or device-memory benchmark.
Ubuntu 1 RTX 4070 and Windows hardware execution were not available to this task, so OPS-05 remains specified.
